notes: Identity verified from title page: title and all seven authors match the supplied Genschow et al. reference; DOI 10.1037/pspa0000261 is printed. The source is a 26-page author manuscript bearing an APA 2020 accepted-manuscript notice, not the copy of record; it contains Method, Results, Discussion, and References. No PDF was supplied. Only n_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. The p. 14 locator and control-comparison description identify the preregistered test (printed χ2 = 2.11, p = .146). The 391 is the final sample across all three conditions, not the analytic N for the two-control comparison. No control-arm final counts or test-specific N are printed in the inspected participants/results sections or Table 1. Table 1 prints percentages only. Do not infer counts from percentages or df. No calculation permitted: the two final control-group counts are not supplied.
